undistort_aria_image: undistort an Aria camera image using device calibration and a linear camera model with specified focal length
undistort_exocam_image: undistort an exocam fisheye image using OpenCV fisheye calibration with provided intrinsics and distortion coefficients
write_attachment_json: write a HALO attachment JSON with 2D and 3D keypoints projected from camera intrinsics and extrinsics
process_aria_data: process Aria camera frames by undistorting images and saving them with HALO attachment JSON metadata
process_exocam_data: process exocam frames by undistorting fisheye images and saving them with HALO attachment JSON metadata
